question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Discreet
solution:
The correct answer is "Open."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Discreet" means careful in what you say and do so as not to cause embarrassment or difficulty for somebody, closed. (सावधान, सतर्क (कि दूसरे को परेशानी न हो), बंद किया हुआ)

 
 
• Example: *‘The family made **discreet**__ enquiries about his background.*
 
 
 
• The word "open" is an antonym of "discreet."
 
• The word "open" means not closed or covered. (खुला, अनढका या अनावृत)
 __
 
• Example:* Suddenly we had left the city behind and were out in **open**__ country.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Release: **the freeing of something or the state of being freed. (किसी की मुक्ति या मुक्ति की स्थिति)
 
• **Zenith: **the highest point that the sun or moon reaches in the sky, directly above you. (आकाश का वह बिंदु जो ठीक सिर के ऊपर हो; शिरोबिंदु, खमध्य)
 
• **Lose: **to become unable to find something. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) खो देना, न पा सकना)
